newsitem.title: SPAIN: MOTORCYCLING-CRIVILLE PLANS COMEBACK AT BRITISH GP.
newsitem.headline: MOTORCYCLING-CRIVILLE PLANS COMEBACK AT BRITISH GP.

text.p: Spaniard Alex Criville, who sustained severe hand injuries in a high-speed crash last month, said on Thursday he planned to return to action at the British motorcyling Grand Prix on August 17.
Criville needed several skin grafts after the crash during qualifying for the Dutch Grand Prix but has made a swift recovery.
Despite missing the last two races, he currently lies fourth in the 500cc world championship behind Australian leader Michael Doohan.
